As the Reith Committee foresaw,"perfect synchronisation of the movement of employing firms with the movement of employed people is not practicable". For short periods over the years some of the London new town corporations have been able to offer a house or a flat at once to anyone eligible for one, but in the main house building has lagged behind the demand.
